isolation.method: unavailable on this host (no unprivileged user/network namespaces) - server processes ran with normal network egress

tools.name: index_repository
tools.description: Index a repository. full/moderate add semantics; fast omits them; cross-repo-intelligence links services. Reports coverage gaps. Waits for the whole i

tools.name: search_graph
tools.description: Find symbols via BM25 query, regex name/qn filters, or semantic_query. Rows keep qn/file/lines and in/out over CALLS/USAGE/CALL_REFERENCE/INHERITS/IMP

tools.name: query_graph
tools.description: Read-only Cypher for multi-hop, aggregation, complexity, or cross-service analysis. Default: 200 visible rows with exact/lower-bound totals and trunca

tools.name: trace_path
tools.description: Trace callers/callees, data flow, or cross-service paths. Defaults exclude tests and resolver evidence. Rows keep qn/hop with explicit totals, relatio

tools.name: get_code_snippet
tools.description: Read a search_graph symbol. auto bounds source and outlines large containers; full restores up to 500 lines. Source/outline pages continue; coverage_n

tools.name: get_file_outline
tools.description: Declaration outline of one exact repository-relative file: optional exact label filter, source order, exact total/offset/limit paging; file/folder/con

tools.name: get_graph_schema
tools.description: Get node-label and edge-type counts. diagnostics=full also lists queryable properties.

tools.name: compare_graphs
tools.description: Compare two indexed snapshots: deterministic target-only additions and base-only removals of stable node/edge identities; each set capped by limit and

tools.name: get_architecture
tools.description: Bounded static architecture; poll pending jobs. include_behavior_evidence=true adds indexed call arguments, parameter declarations and return types; n

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Graph-ranked text search: compact symbols, full bounded source, or file paths.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects with stable paging. Identity is lean; stats adds graph sizes.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project from the index

tools.name: index_status
tools.description: Project readiness, counts, root, watch state, coverage gaps, and doc_links (doc-comment references: MENTIONS edges, unresolved by reason). diagnostics

tools.name: check_index_coverage
tools.description: Best-effort exact-path/scope coverage and freshness, paged separately. full diagnostics adds raw detail. Clean is not proof of completeness.

tools.name: detect_changes
tools.description: Map a Git diff to files and impact. Page with snapshot cursors.

tools.name: manage_adr
tools.description: Outline an ADR by default; get reads it; update replaces it

tools.name: ingest_traces
tools.description: Record observed runtime calls so the graph can distinguish observed from merely possible paths. Each trace is a call path (qualified names, adjacent =
